name: Dashi
description: Kombu and bonito steeped briefly — the savoury base under almost all Japanese cooking.

tcm.note: Kelp is cold; the bonito warms it. Net cooling, and very light.

ayurveda.note: Outside the classical record; a sea-vegetable broth, read as shita.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; placed with the sea vegetables.

histamine.note: Both its ingredients are among the highest on the SIGHI list — dried seaweed and mould-fermented fish. It is under almost everything Japanese, which is worth knowing.

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.
